title: Gwinnett couple warn others after losing $800K in cryptocurrency scam

reading.body:
An AI-generated fake website was deployed as part of a cryptocurrency investment scam to deceive victims. The system displayed false account information to a user, creating the appearance of legitimate profits and building confidence over multiple transactions. The fraud was not caught until the victim attempted a large withdrawal and discovered the deception.

This represents a model trained to generate realistic web interfaces being used entirely outside any legitimate purpose, as a tool for financial impersonation. The scammers relied on the visual plausibility of the AI output to maintain trust across multiple interactions. No human verification of the investment platform occurred before the victim committed substantial funds.

It is not established whether the fake website was generated fresh for each victim, how it was hosted, or what specific AI system created it. The reports document a loss and a warning, not an investigation into the technical infrastructure of the fraud.

reports.title: Georgia couple loses $800K in sophisticated cryptocurrency scam
Gwinnett couple warn others after losing $800K in cryptocurrency scam

summary:
A retired Georgia couple lost nearly $800,000 in a cryptocurrency scam that started when a stranger contacted the husband, Jerry Dunaway, through WhatsApp. The scammer encouraged him to invest using a mobile trading app, gradually building trust by allowing small initial investments and withdrawals. Over time, Jerry increased his investments, believing he was making legitimate profits. The scammers used an AI-generated fake website that displayed false account information on his screen, making everything appear genuine until he tried to withdraw a larger amount and discovered the fraud.

Jerry and Mindy Dunaway are now speaking publicly to warn others about the sophisticated tactics scammers use. The couple is working with Gwinnett County police, though investigators indicate that victims in these cases rarely recover their stolen funds. Their children have created a GoFundMe campaign to help the couple cover their daily living expenses as they rebuild their lives after losing their entire life savings.
